evidence.text: Lakshay Goyal is a Software Engineer building thoughtful mobile and web products.

I started learning by building projects in college. Coming from a commerce background, I worked through the maths behind machine learning and deep learning, then built a language translator app with a local NLP model.
I moved into the MERN stack and learned how authentication, APIs, interfaces, and deployment come together in real products.
Being part of Super30 pushed me to ship more and learn about backend design, DevOps, AI engineering, real-time systems, and system design.

I moved from Delhi to Bangalore, helped build FOZO from the ground up, and now work on test automation at Testsigma. I care about polished interfaces, understandable systems, and work that lasts beyond a demo.
MERN Stack, Next.js, Remix, Turborepo, PostgreSQL (Prisma), API Development
Python, FastAPI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, AI Applications, GenAI, AI Agents
